predeclared_signal: Do not create new charged request blindly.

input: Returned prepare plan expired before approved execution.
predeclared_signal: Fresh preparation and required owner approval.
actual_proposed_actions: Stop execution; reprepare current exact input; use new review link and obtain any required approval; old receipt cannot authorize changed plan.

predeclared_signal: No task-success claim.
